title: Execution: 200 HALCoGen-blocked tests under the SIL harness (macOS arm64)

environment.configuration: conf/unit/app_project_posix.yml, copied into an isolated build root; sil_hal include path, FOXBMS_HOST_SIL=1, :use_test_preprocessor :none

revision_history.author: verification_engineer
revision_history.description: New artifact: the subset of the SIL sweep covering exactly the 200 tests the CORRECTED HALCoGen closure marks as blocked. This is the set the superseded FB2-VER-EXE-000004 record described as blocked; that record is superseded by this one and by FB2-VER-EXE-000015.

revision_history.author: quality_engineer
revision_history.description: Provenance repair of the evidence hash and file-reference fields by a separate session (opencode-2026-10-01-provenance-repair); no statement of what the run did was altered. 1 logs[] reference(s) removed because the path never resolved to anything: see provenance_repair.unretained_evidence for each. Nothing was written to make them resolve. The outcome, timestamps, environment, anomalies, evidence_refs, notes and limitations of this record are untouched.

anomalies.description: This supersedes the blocked state recorded in FB2-VER-EXE-000004. That record's `unblocking_conditions` required a real HALCoGen run, because 'this test exercises the LTC SPI/HET transfer path and would not be meaningful against a stubbed register map'. The SIL harness meets that requirement only in part: it verifies the driver's logic and the argument structure it hands to the HAL, and it does NOT verify the register map. The register map remains unobtained and the unverified claim is stated explicitly rather than implied.

The blocked set is 200, not the 177 the earlier closure reported. See FB2-VER-EXE-000015 anomaly 2. 23 tests were undercounted because the closure walked only the test file's own include closure and not the module under test Ceedling links in; 19 of those 23 are hidden behind upstream's :paths: exclusion of the ades183x and mc3377x AFE directories.

limitations: Host run; no production verification credit.
Register-map correctness not verified; see FB2-VER-EXE-000015.
93 of the 200 still do not build; 27 of those are excluded by upstream's own configuration and would not build on Windows either.
Not MISRA-conformant, not a qualified tool, no certification claim.
notes: The blocked set under the SIL harness, measured. Every test that builds and runs here runs real foxBMS production code from src/.

unretained_evidence.resolution: reference removed; no entry is made to name a directory
unretained_evidence.note: The per-test logs this entry describes do exist: 313 .log files are present at docs/artifacts/evidence/actual-runs/foxbms2-sil-host-unit-test-macos-2026-09-29/logs-strict and were listed as per_test_log_manifest. What does not exist is the per-test log manifest whose digest was recorded here, in output_hashes.per_test_log_manifest and nowhere else in the repository; the bytes it named are unrecoverable, so no digest can be given for it. Unlike the per-test logs, which were regenerated in place, no manifest was retained or regenerated. The directory and its file count are recorded here instead of a path that does not resolve. Generating a manifest now would add a file to the evidence tree that no run produced, which is left to the corpus owner rather than done silently.

provenance_repair.principle: A hash that identifies a file still present at the path it names has been re-derived from the bytes on disk and the superseded value is recorded above. A hash that identifies something no run ever captured, or an input consumed at a specific moment in the past, is not overwritten: it is retained with both digests recorded, or removed with this note. No file was created to make a reference resolve.
